description: Implementation of MD5 hash functions including initialization, update, finalization, and transformation routines within the google_breakpad namespace.

classes.name: MD5Context
classes.description: Structure holding the state of an MD5 computation, including buffer and bit count.

methods.name: MD5Init
methods.description: Initializes the MD5 context with starting constants and zeroed bit counts.

methods.name: MD5Update
methods.description: Updates the MD5 context with new data buffers, processing in 64-byte chunks.

methods.name: MD5Final
methods.description: Finalizes the MD5 hash, padding the data and producing the 16-byte digest.

methods.name: MD5Transform
methods.description: Core transformation function that processes 16-word blocks to update the hash state.
